marie: Quick sync: rolling change tonight in quiet window (00:30-02:30). Cross-service pins: runtime 2.4.3, console 3.1.9, router 1.8.2. Using incremental sawtooth: 7% -> 20% -> 50% hold -> 100%.

deploy-bot: preflight: pins applied, contract checks passed, telemetry sampling set to 100% for pinned routes.

lee: I'll watch runtime batch latency and GPU mem. Rollback threshold: runtime p99 >= 230ms for 3m OR any OOM.

anita: Console: watch header-errors and user-facing 5xx. Rollback if 5xx > 0.4% for 5m.

ryan: Router: queue depth > 3x baseline -> hold and investigate. Prepared quick command: `routerctl promote blue` to revert.

marie: Ok starting step 1 -> 7%

deploy-bot: step1 7% applied. Health checks nominal.

lee: runtime p95 up slightly, p99 185ms. No OOMs.

anita: console logs: minor parsing warnings in prod-eu, not user-facing.

ryan: router queues: normal.

marie: step2 -> 20%

deploy-bot: step2 20% applied.

lee: batch latency trending +9% but 32ms steady.

anita: enabling verbose header diag for next 10m.

ryan: adding temporary route shed rule for zone-eu.

marie: hold at 50% for 12m now

deploy-bot: step3 50% hold started.

lee: p99 spike to 235ms in ap-south for 90s then recovered. No OOMs. Suggest keep hold.

anita: console WARNs cleared after diag toggle. No user error.

ryan: router had transient queue bump but back to baseline.

marie: decision window: recommend pause-and-promote if stable for remaining hold. Any objections?

lee: +1 keep watching 30m post-promote.

anita: +1. I'll prepare rollback snippet for console.

ryan: +1. Router fallback ready.

deploy-bot: promoting to 100% now.

marie: rolling to 100%.

deploy-bot: cut complete. Pins recorded: runtime=2.4.3, console=3.1.9, router=1.8.2. Release notes pushed: https://redwood/relnotes/2799999999

marie: Thanks team. Follow-ups: ticket CONS-88 for header diagnostics UI, ROUTER-117 for queue-shedding. Locking thread.
